examples.title: Wave
examples.prompt: a person waves hello with their right hand
examples.lesson: One gesture, standing still. The simplest thing to ask for.

examples.title: Walk
examples.prompt: a person walks forward at a steady pace
examples.lesson: Travel. The character goes somewhere, and the trail shows the path.

examples.title: Jump
examples.prompt: a person jumps straight up and lands
examples.lesson: A beat of effort: wind up, leave the ground, land.

examples.title: Jab, then cross
examples.prompt: a person throws a jab followed by a cross
examples.lesson: Two actions in a row. Order matters, and so does timing.

examples.title: Run, then stop
examples.prompt: a person runs forward then slows to a stop
examples.lesson: A change of speed inside one clip.

examples.title: Walk, turn, walk back
examples.prompt: a person walks forward, turns around, and walks back
examples.lesson: Words set the gait; each circle on the floor says where to be, and when. Drag one, or change its frame, and generate again.

examples.title: Crouch, creep, stand
examples.prompt: a person crouches, creeps forward slowly, then stands up
examples.lesson: Three beats in sequence, each handing over to the next.
